title: measuretwice calibration plan (v0)
description: Owner-selected goals and the permitted policy family for one calibration. A plan declares targets and procedure. It does not carry universal default error tolerances. Rust validates the cross-field invariants listed in the contracts README.

intended_population.description: Declared population for the qualification claim.

sampling_assumptions.description: Grouping strategy and independence assumptions. Unsupported assumptions must be reported, not assumed.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level for uncertainty intervals. Unsupported levels are rejected.

comparison.description: Direction of the limit. Error and review metrics use at_most. Coverage metrics use at_least.

basis.description: Upper confidence bound compares the interval upper bound with the limit. Zero observed errors are not proof of zero risk.

constraints.description: Goals that a candidate must satisfy. State the metric and denominator exactly.

metric.description: Quantity that fitting minimizes or maximizes after all constraints hold.

minimum_samples.description: Minimum counts by denominator name. Example keys: labeled_cases, accepted_cases, reference_pass_cases, reference_fail_or_review_cases.

tag.description: Case tag that must meet its own evidence requirements.

important_slices.description: Slices that the plan checks separately.

confidence_floors.description: Optional abstention floors. Each used floor must be recorded and evaluated in the candidate.

candidate_grid.description: Permitted candidate family. Both cutoffs must exceed 0.5. Array order declares the enumeration order. The accept dimension is the outer loop. The first optimum in this order wins a tie.

translation_hash.description: Canonical hash of the translated questions.

model_requested.description: Model identifier requested for fitting and validation.

evaluator.description: Registered evaluator configuration used for all measurements in this plan.

datasets.description: Fitting and validation data. Rust verifies that the two selections use different splits.

content_hash.description: Canonical plan hash. Computed with the hashing contract.
Hash of the canonical split content.
